title: Concept: Value-carrying external call (solidity) — review required
description: In solidity, a value-carrying call hands control to the recipient. If state is updated after the call, the recipient re-enters and repeats the withdrawal. The remedy is a reentrancy guard and checks-effects-interactions order.
applicability: solidity contracts that send value; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Repeated withdrawals and drained balances; HIGH severity.
